text:
팀 켈러의 어떤 설교 중에서
이 부분을
en: In one of his sermons, Tim Keller
sums this up in one line.
He says it to pastors:
"To preach about idols, you must risk your life."
That's what he says.
Our idols must break before we can come to God,

text:
절대로 우상을
깨뜨리고 싶지 않은 거죠
en: but we never want them broken.
They're our security.
Touch someone's idol and it's "I'll kill you."
That's how strong idols are.
They hold enormous power.
And those idols are inside us.

text:
그 우상이 가득한 시대에서
우리가 살아가고 있는 거죠
en: We live in an age full of idols.
To save us out of it,
Christ died.
Breaking idols costs a life,
and Christ gave his.
By his death Christ made a way
to rescue us from this evil world's countless idols.
He opened that way.
That's love.

text:
돈과 통제와 안정과 당신이
추구하는 그 어떤 것보다
en: More than money, control, security, or anything you chase,
Christ, with the deepest security and love,
promises, "I will take care of your life."
May that grace of the gospel
overflow in us.
